script: In weeks eight and nine, send fifteen to twenty messages every week. By the end, at least forty messages should be sent and logged. In week ten, prepare your pricing and a proposal template, and save them so you can reuse them. In week eleven, deliver your first job. The client accepts the work, and you send an invoice. In week twelve, ask for a review, and plan the next ninety days. A review is your proof, and the next plan is your route to a steady income. Before you finish the plan, look back at what you have done in these thirteen chapters. You chose a skill, built a learning route, made samples, set up your profiles, found clients, priced your work, delivered a job, protected yourself from scams and planned your growth. Each step is a small business skill, and together they form a complete career path. If one step feels weak, go back to its chapter and repeat its checklist. Do not skip the weak step, because it affects the others.
